23 September 2026, 00:00

Treasure,

I'm writing this early, coz if I leave it till midnight I'll try to say all of it in one voice note and lose half of it somewhere around the second minute.

I met you as a voice. You volunteered to mock-interview a stranger and I sat there thinking you sounded like someone who had already done all of this before. I didn't know your face for months. There's no record of that call anywhere, and I used to hate that. I don't anymore. Everything after it got written down, and it turns out we wrote a lot.

Here is what a year and a half of that adds up to. You are kind to people who have not earned it. You carry your family's weight and call it a perk of being a first born. You laugh at exactly the wrong moment, every time, and I have stopped hoping you'll grow out of it. You overthink, and then you apologise for overthinking, which is somehow worse. And you are the only person I have ever met who answers a question about what she loves with the word healer.

I'm not going to promise you anything enormous. Distance is still distance and next year is still next year. What I'll say instead is that there are sixty-odd Saturdays left on a calendar I booked before I had any right to, and I'd like to spend every one of them with you on the other end of it.

I hope 17 is good to you. I hope you get to do more of the things you love, make things you're proud of, laugh at things you shouldn't, and keep becoming whoever it is you're slowly turning into. And selfishly, I hope I get to see a lot of that version of you too.

Happy birthday, you. I'm really glad that voice decided to answer that mock interview.

Seventeen looks good on you already.
